title: Lucidity at a bus stop
content: I became lucid during a Mall World dream the other night. I was at a bus stop, maybe a train stop, and was talking to a guy there. I was telling him I had a job interview, a date, and I also had to return some movies I rented, but I became lucid and told the guy I'm absolutely lying to him, there was no job interview, no date, and I didn't have to return any movies. I apologized for lying, but the guy was trying to convince me that it was all true. I think I broke my Mall World immersion.
